sentences.en: His diplomatic passport entitles him to immunity from criminal prosecution.
sentences.zh: 他的外交护照使他免受刑事起诉。

sentences.en: He couldn't be charged because he had diplomatic immunity.
sentences.zh: 由于享有外交豁免权，他不能被起诉。

sentences.en: For now, Naima Salhi, a fascist clown, enjoys full parliamentary immunity.
sentences.zh: 目前，纳伊玛·萨尔希，一个法西斯小丑，享有完全的议会豁免权。

senses.zh: 免疫力；豁免权，免除；免责，豁免
